scope: isolated D020_E772 central pilots; never production

closure_definition.interpretation: No tail form or preferred amplitude is imposed below the threshold; the penalty acts only when the sampled finite-b interval has not numerically closed.

explicit_coordinate_robustness.interpretation: The C2 attenuation coordinate is exactly zero below b_start and constant after b_end, so it supplies a well-conditioned numerical-closure direction without modifying the fitted core or the base asymptotic rate.

selection: Use the weakest lambda satisfying the declared Fourier gate, then require stability across adjacent closure thresholds before any multistart promotion.
